title: implement outcome
description: The outcome of an implement session of bl run (feature-story.md, story-run.md), its final message (F-68 D2). The loop still decides from the story's acceptance criteria and the unit's ## Escalation; it records the summary, and names blocked when it escalates unmet criteria.

summary.description: One line: what the session did.

done.description: true when every acceptance criterion of the story is checked off.

blocked.description: What stopped the session, in one line. blocked is a string exactly when done is false, and null when done is true.
